tools.name: ReadArtifact
tools.description: Reads a saved command-output prefix by artifact ID from the current thread. Offsets and limits count raw bytes; partial storage EOF does not mean complete command output.

artifact_id.description: Opaque saved-output ID from a committed command result

tools.name: Glob
tools.description: Finds regular files in the local workspace using a deterministic workspace-relative glob pattern.

pattern.description: Workspace-relative glob pattern; ** matches complete path segments

tools.name: Grep
tools.description: Searches UTF-8 text files in the local workspace using deterministic line-oriented RE2 semantics.

tools.name: apply_patch
tools.description: The `apply_patch` tool edits one existing file. This is a FREEFORM tool, so do not wrap the patch in JSON.

format.definition:
start: begin update hunk+ end LF?
begin: "*** Begin Patch" LF
update: "*** Update File: " path LF
hunk: "@@" LF hunk_line+
hunk_line: (" " | "-" | "+") line LF
end: "*** End Patch"
path: /[^\r\n]+/
line: /[^\r\n]*/
LF: "\n"

tools.name: Read
tools.description: Reads a UTF-8 text file from the local workspace with stable 1-based line numbers.

file_path.description: The absolute or workspace-relative path to the file to read

offset.description: The 1-based line number to start reading from

limit.description: The maximum number of lines to read

tools.name: Write
tools.description: Creates or overwrites one UTF-8 workspace file with exact content after approval. Overwriting requires a complete Read delivered in an earlier sample; truncated or same-sample reads do not qualify. Missing parent directories are created atomically. Use Edit or apply_patch for partial changes.

file_path.description: Canonical workspace-relative file path (at most 4096 bytes and 64 components)

content.description: Exact UTF-8 file content; empty content is allowed. Input is limited to 1 MiB.

tools.name: exec_command
tools.description: Runs a foreground command after one-time approval, with workspace writes, no network, bounded output and timeout.

command.description: Foreground non-interactive shell command, at most 64 KiB UTF-8. Detached processes are unsupported.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description: Loads complete local skill instructions by name, or reads a relative supporting resource from the same source. Does not grant tool permissions. args and resource are mutually exclusive.

tools.name: request_user_input
tools.description: Asks the user one to four questions with single or multiple choices and optional notes, then waits for explicit answers. The client adds Other. Put a recommended choice first with (Recommended) in its label. Ask before generating tool calls whose parameters depend on the answer. Answers never grant tool permissions. Requires an interactive host.
